what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Morocco, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5216 Syrian refugees in Morocco, 0.1% of all refugees from Syria.
Türkiye hosts the most Syrian refugees, followed by Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 9 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 5777, at the end of 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Morocco.
These are year-end totals for Morocco only, reported to UNHCR.
